findings.issue_summary: **Silent Background Transfer**: Policy violation. Data is sent without prior disclosure.
findings.evidence: app/src/main/java/com/musically/studio/MyApplication.kt:30 unconditionally initializes CrashlyticsTree() in onCreate(), transferring performance diagnostics before the WelcomeScreen consent dialog can act as a gatekeeper.
findings.recommendation: Delay the initialization of Crashlytics and other telemetry SDKs until after the user has explicitly accepted the Privacy Policy in the WelcomeScreen.
